name: push-up-stability-ball
title: Push-Up: Stability Ball
primer: This is similar to the standard Push Up except using a Stability Ball forces you to engage the muscles of your core (Rectus Abdominis, Transverse Abdominis, and the Obliques).
steps: Place your feet and shins flat on a Stability Ball.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder width apart, directly under your shoulders, and press up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top for a moment and steady your balance.
Slowly return to the starting position with your chest lowered towards the ground.
